newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs end off in weak trade, awaiting rates.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs end off in weak trade, awaiting rates.

text.p: Brazilian stocks pared some early losses, but still ended down in light trade as many investors stayed away to await possible changes in U.S. and local interest rates, brokers said.
"There was no local news and the market was sideways, following New York all day," one dealer said. "Everyone is waiting to see what happens to interest rates."
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index .BVSP of 49 most traded shares dropped 366 points to close at 65,517 points, off 0.55 percent.
Among blue chips, Telebras's benchmark preferred slipped 0.12 percent to close at 81.20 reais, while its voting ordinary ended down 0.37 percent at 67.05 reais.
Other leading shares also fell, led by state oil monopoly Petrobras.
Petrobras preferred closed down 1.24 percent at percent higher at 119.00 reais and state mining giant Vale do Rio Doce preferred slid 0.24 percent to 20.80 reais.
Blue-chip power firm Eletrobras fell 1.01 percent to end at 294.00 reais.
Bucking the general slide was steelmaker Cia Siderurgica Nacional (CSN), which rose 0.88 percent to end at 22.80 reais.
